title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 372 (Power of Court to stay or restrain proceedings)

content.overview: The provisions of this Act with respect to staying and restraining suits and other legal proceedings against a company at any time after the presentation of a petition for winding up and before the making of a winding-up order shall, in the case of a company registered in pursuance of this Part, apply as if the reference to the presentation of the petition were a reference to the presentation of the petition for winding up under this Part.
content.glance: Stay/restrain provisions after presentation of winding-up petition apply to companies registered under this Part with adapted reference.
